verdict.rationale: CIPO runs online filing services (Apply for/amend a trademark, MyCIPO Patents), so publishing service hours, daily limits, or session timeouts is a fair question for this product. None of the evidence mentions an operating-hours window, a per-day limit, or a session timeout being disclosed before a user starts. The only timing item is a forecast of examination wait time, which is a different subject.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
